sequence.description: Verify website, Instagram, target contact, product references and two actual ads. Create one task per brand with an evidence record.
Produce a brand-specific hook and category joke, exact script and ImageGen frames. Log tools, sources, elapsed time, recorded cost or unknown.
Check identity, anatomy, garments, composition and script-to-frame coverage. Failures return to ideation with findings.
Ryan or a named authorized creative reviewer sees frames, script and product refs. Terac respondents may provide scored feedback. A study opinion does not itself approve spend.
Show the current itemized estimate, model IDs, quantities and retry cap. Record explicit production budget authorization.
Generate neutral short source clips only after cost approval. Preserve source frames and original voice reference.
Apply exact apparel references through Genjutsu. Create the brand-name voice and matching lip animation separately. Assemble the final video and deterministic end link.
Inspect every decoded frame plus joins and audio timing. Keep timecoded findings and coverage counts. Any major failure returns to the affected production stage within the approved retry budget.
Ryan or authorized production reviewer watches the full clip with sound and confirms product accuracy, pronunciation and suitability. Terac feedback can support this review.
Copy the approved two-page master, replace approved variables only, insert actual brand logo and ad images, and verify the final PDF and links.
Attach video, PDF, logo, Instagram, ad sources and exact message in the same brand task. Approval binds to recipient, channel and attachment hashes.
Require explicit sending authorization for the intended recipient or a separately authorized bounded campaign. Concept approval is not sending approval.
Record provider message/thread IDs and timestamps only after provider acknowledgement. Reconcile ambiguous results before retrying.
Start reply watching only when the live integration and monitoring are authorized. A send receipt does not prove the prospect opened or read it.
Dedupe on provider message ID. Save the original reply, classify it and update CRM with timestamp, confidence and next action.
Draft a relevant reply. For interest, ask about goals, products, usage, deliverables and timing. Offer a call using actual availability. Draft deal terms within approved pricing.
Record won only from confirmed acceptance/payment evidence. Negative replies suppress follow-ups. Keep booked, proposal sent, paid and delivered as distinct stages.

teracReviewDraft.respondents: Use the actual available Terac audience. Record who reviewed; do not describe general respondents as brand decision-makers.
questions: Does the character look like the same person in every frame?
Can you identify what clothing is being shown?
Does the first line make the recipient and purpose clear?
Which line or pose feels awkward? Cite the panel.
Would you watch the sample and open the brief? Why?
teracReviewDraft.budget: Quote before launching a paid study.

replyRoutes.interested: Draft discovery questions and a call invitation. Do not commit unapproved scope, terms or calendar times.
replyRoutes.pricing: Use the approved 10-ad proposal and current authorized terms. Flag requests for discounts or different guarantees.
replyRoutes.wrong_person: Ask for the relevant creative contact only within the authorized reply workflow.
replyRoutes.out_of_office: Do not count as interest. Record the stated return date.
replyRoutes.negative: Stop the sequence and suppress further automated outreach.

crm.followups: Draft first; cadence and sending require campaign authorization. Stop on any substantive reply, opt-out or bounce.
